topic: How Contractors Get 5 Local Leads a Month Using Only One Craigslist Post
title: One Craigslist Post = 5 Local Leads (Contractors)
title_options: Get 5 Local Leads with One Craigslist Ad
Craigslist Hack for Contractors: 5 Leads a Month
Single Craigslist Post That Brings Local Calls
description:
A simple Craigslist playbook for contractors who do marketing themselves. Use one well-crafted post, one clear offer, and one follow-up step to get local calls.

This short shows the exact wording, an example for a plumber, and real steps you can copy. Costs are low and setup takes about 20 minutes.

scenes.narration: One Craigslist post, five local leads?
scenes.doodle_prompt: a single paper post with five phone icons around it

scenes.narration: Make one targeted Craigslist ad. Offer a clear, limited-time fix: same-week service and a visible price range.
Use a short headline: Plumbing—Same-Day Leak Repair, $99–$249 estimate. Put towns you serve in the body.
scenes.doodle_prompt: a plumber icon next to a house map pin

scenes.narration: Example text: "Same-day leak repair. Estimates $99–$249. Serving Northside, Oak Park. Call or text 555‑1234 — available today."
When calls come, confirm availability and send a quick Google Maps pin and a photo of your van — builds trust fast.
scenes.doodle_prompt: phone sending map pin to a house, van parked nearby

scenes.narration: One clear offer, one local post, follow-up trust steps. Follow Blue Ocean Marketing for one marketing fix every day.
